features.name: Universal Agent Brain Sync
features.description: Unified knowledge base that syncs across all AI agents (Antigravity, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Perplexity, ChatGPT Desktop, Codex, Replit, Lovable, etc.). Single source of truth in ~/.nucleus/brain/ with automatic bidirectional sync to agent-native formats via MCP.
how_to_test: Initialize multiple agents: nucleus init antigravity, nucleus init cursor
Save knowledge in one agent: brain_add_strategy()
Verify knowledge appears in other agent's context
Test bidirectional sync by editing agent-native config
Verify changes propagate to Nucleus brain
features.expected_result: All agents share same knowledge base. Saving in Antigravity makes content available to Cursor, Windsurf, etc. Registry auto-grows with new agents.
